MonthlyTimeSheet.description: The live monthly time sheet of an employee for the open (in-progress) period of the Control Horario (time tracking) module. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by employee + month, so it exposes `employee_id` (UUID v7) and never an `id`. Totals are in minutes; `days` is the daily breakdown. It is recomputed on every request, so a just-recorded clock entry is reflected without closing the month. The `total_*` fields cover the whole month and, in the current month, are a projection; `to_date` holds the actual accumulation of the closed days (every day before today).

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the sheet belongs to.

total_expected_minutes.description: Total expected working minutes of the whole month, including today and the remaining days (holidays, approved absences, days without a schedule and days outside the employment period already count as 0).

total_worked_minutes.description: Total worked minutes of the month so far, today included.

total_balance_minutes.description: Month balance in minutes as the sum of the daily balances. In the current month it is a projection that already subtracts the expected minutes of today and of the remaining days; use `to_date.balance_minutes` for the actual balance.

total_overtime_minutes.description: Total overtime minutes of the month.

days.description: Daily breakdown of the month. Each day includes `is_unscheduled` and `is_outside_employment`.

NifTransfer.description: A voucher that hands ONE NIF of an account over to another account. Issuing one is already giving away control of that NIF: whoever accepts the secret gets the NIF, and taking it back requires the OTHER party to act. The plaintext secret is NOT part of this representation and cannot be: only its irreversible fingerprint is stored, so no later read can return it.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the tax ID transfer, a UUID v7.

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the NIF this transfer gives away.

expires_at.description: Expiry instant (ISO 8601).

status.description: DERIVED state, read against the clock: the table has no status column. `revoked` means the issuing account withdrew it before anyone accepted it. A consumed or revoked transfer and one that never existed are deliberately indistinguishable on acceptance.

recipient_account_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the ONLY account that can accept this transfer, or `null` when whoever holds the secret can accept it.

issued_at.description: When the transfer was issued (ISO 8601), or `null` when the instant is not recorded.

consumed_at.description: When the transfer was accepted (ISO 8601), or `null` while nobody accepted it. It does not say WHICH account accepted it.

revoked_at.description: When the issuing account revoked the transfer (ISO 8601), or `null` if it was not revoked.

NifTransferWithSecret.description: The issuance response of a tax ID transfer: the fields of `NifTransfer` PLUS the plaintext `secret`. This is the ONLY representation that carries it, and the only time it is ever returned — it is not stored in the clear, not even in the idempotency cache, so an idempotent replay of the issuance returns `secret: null`. If it is lost, revoke the transfer and issue another one.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the tax ID transfer, a UUID v7.

company_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the NIF this transfer gives away.

expires_at.description: Expiry instant (ISO 8601).

recipient_account_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the ONLY account that can accept this transfer, or `null` when whoever holds the secret can accept it.

issued_at.description: When the transfer was issued (ISO 8601), or `null` when the instant is not recorded.

consumed_at.description: When the transfer was accepted (ISO 8601), or `null` while nobody accepted it. It does not say WHICH account accepted it.

revoked_at.description: When the issuing account revoked the transfer (ISO 8601), or `null` if it was not revoked.

secret.description: The plaintext secret, returned ONCE and never again. Treat it as a credential: anyone holding it can take the NIF (or only the recipient account, when one is set). `null` only in an idempotent replay of the issuance, because the secret is never stored.

PhoneString.description: Permissive international phone number: optional `+`, digits, spaces, hyphens and parentheses (6..20 characters).
PhoneString.title: PhoneString

PickingListLine.description: One line of a picking list: ONE item to take out of the warehouse, with the SNAPSHOT of the description and of the product the line was created with. The snapshot is the point: editing the delivery note afterwards does not rewrite what the warehouse was told to pick, it marks the list as stale.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the picking line, a UUID v7. It is the key the picking addresses: `POST .../picking-lines/{picking_line}/pick` says how much of THIS line was picked. The identifier is unique per company, so the line resolves without walking through its list, and a line belonging to ANOTHER delivery note is rejected.

position.description: Deterministic position of the line inside the list, so two reads render the same order.

description.description: Description of what has to be picked, SNAPSHOT of the line of the delivery note at the moment the list was opened.

product_id.description: Opaque identifier of the item to pick, snapshot of the line. This key is ABSENT — not `null` — on a free-text line, which has no item behind it.

quantity_to_pick.description: Quantity that has to be picked, as a decimal string with four decimal places — the scale of the quantities of the catalog. It is a string and never a floating-point number: this is the figure the ceiling of what can be picked hangs on.

picked_quantity.description: Quantity picked so far, with the same scale. This key is ABSENT — not `null` — while the line has never been picked, because a `null` would say "it was picked and the amount is nothing". Picking above `quantity_to_pick` is rejected as a business rule violation BEFORE anything is written.

picked_at.description: When the line was picked (ISO 8601). This key is ABSENT while it never was. It is INDEPENDENT of `picked_quantity`: undoing a picking leaves the instant recorded and the quantity gone, and that combination is real and not hypothetical. The ACTOR of the picking is deliberately NOT published: it is a foreign key into the user master and no identifier of ours travels as an internal integer.

is_fully_picked.description: Whether the picked quantity already covers the quantity to pick. It is DERIVED and never stored.

PickingListLine.title: PickingListLine

PickingQueueItem.description: One element of the WORK QUEUE of the warehouse: a delivery note with its picking open, seen from the shop floor. It is a deliberately THIN projection of the picking list — it carries no lines, no counts and no staleness indicator — because the queue is the screen that paints the most rows and resolving all that per row would be one query per line. Whoever picks one opens its picking list.

delivery_note_id.description: Opaque identifier of the delivery note. It is both the identity of the element and the key of its picking list.

delivery_note_number.description: Readable number of the delivery note. `null` when the note has not been numbered yet.

fulfilment_status.description: Status of the physical axis of the delivery note. It is the field the `fulfilment_status` filter of the queue narrows by.

fulfilment_status_label.description: Label of the physical status in Spanish.

warehouse_id.description: Opaque identifier of the origin warehouse. This key is ABSENT — not `null` — when the note does not pin one. It is also a filter of the queue.

sales_order_id.description: Opaque identifier of the sales order the note came from, published WITHOUT its number and without its name: the client already has the order resource to read them. This key is ABSENT when there is no order behind the note. It is also a filter of the queue.

PickingQueueItem.title: PickingQueueItem

PreviewProductBaseUnitReplacementRequest.description:
Body of the base unit replacement preview: the new base unit, the equivalence between both units, an optional
price to confirm and one `keep` or `retire` decision per presentation of the product being replaced.

target_base_unit.description: Base unit of the new product. Only the nine measure units are accepted: a packaging unit (`XPK`, `XBX`…) can only be a presentation unit.

equivalence.description:
Units of the CURRENT base that equal ONE unit of the NEW base (moving from kg to g,
1 g = 0.001 kg, so `0.001`; from kg to count units, 1 unit = 0.5 kg gives `0.5`). Required
between a count unit and a measure unit; inside the same measure family it is calculated
and between two different measure families there is none.

base_price.description:
Base price of the new product per its base unit. Confirm it when the conversion loses
precision or there is no equivalence.

presentations.description: Decision per presentation of the product being replaced. Presentations you omit get the proposed decision.

id.description: Id (UUID v7) of a presentation of the product being replaced.

decision.description: `keep` moves the presentation to the new product; `retire` withdraws it.

PreviewProductBaseUnitReplacementRequest.title: PreviewProductBaseUnitReplacementRequest

entry_ids.description: Concrete time entries to invoice (mutually exclusive with `period`).

period.description: Period, by the start date of the entries (mutually exclusive with `entry_ids`).

grouping.description: How the invoice lines are grouped.

PreviewTaxReportV1Request.description: Compute the breakdown of a tax report without persisting any generation or file. Useful to show what is about to be declared before confirming. `303` and `347` are accepted as aliases of `modelo_303` and `modelo_347`, consistent with `POST /v1/companies/{company}/tax-reports/303` and `POST /v1/companies/{company}/tax-reports/347`.
PreviewTaxReportV1Request.title: PreviewTaxReportV1Request

PriceListItem.description: A price entry of a price list. Listing endpoints accept `?search=`, which filters and paginates server-side over the visible names of the target: product, variant, presentation, commercial combination and option values.

configuration_id.description: The stored commercial combination the entry is priced for. `null` when the entry targets the legacy product/variant/presentation crossing or a selection signature: the three ways of naming a target are mutually exclusive. On a withdrawn entry it is read from the frozen snapshot, never from the live catalog.

selection_signature.description: Canonical 64-hex signature of the normalized selection the entry is priced for, when it targets the selection itself instead of a stored combination. `null` otherwise. On a withdrawn entry it is read from the frozen snapshot, never from the live catalog.

status.description: Lifecycle of the entry. `retired` means a confirmed catalog deletion withdrew it: it keeps its price as history, is excluded from price resolution, client assignment and every statistic, and is never reactivated.

retirement_reason.description: Why the entry was withdrawn. `product_replaced` means the product was replaced by another one with a different base unit (`POST /v1/companies/{company}/products/{product}/base-unit-replacement`): the entry keeps its price as history and, when it was transferred, a new entry for the new product carries the converted price. `null` while the entry is active.

retirement_reason_label.description: Human-readable label of `retirement_reason`, in Spanish. `null` while the entry is active.

retired_target_snapshot.description: Snapshot of the target taken when the entry was withdrawn. It is read from the entry itself, never from the live catalog, so it still describes the entry after the product is gone. `null` while the entry is active.

PriceListItem.title: PriceListItem

PriceListItemCollection.description: Cursor-paginated price entries. `has_more` and `next_cursor` are computed over the FILTERED set when `?search=` is supplied, not over the whole price list.
PriceListItemCollection.title: PriceListItemCollection

stock.description: Available stock quantity with four-decimal scale.

base_unit.description: UNECE base unit code. Only the nine measure units can be a base unit (`C62`, `KGM`, `GRM`, `LTR`, `MLT`, `MTR`, `MTK`, `HUR`, `DAY`); a packaging or count unit (`H87`, `XPK`, `XBX`…) can only be the unit of a presentation or a supplier offer. It cannot be edited once the product has history: see `base_unit_change` and `POST /v1/companies/{company}/products/{product}/base-unit-replacement`.

gross_weight_kg.description: Gross transport weight in kg per BASE unit (decimal string, up to 4 decimals, greater than 0), packaging included; `null` when unknown. Rejected with 422 `gross_weight_not_allowed` for services and for products whose base unit is a mass unit (`KGM`, `GRM`), where the weight is the quantity itself. A variant weight replaces it for that variant; a fixed presentation may declare its own weight per commercial unit.

manage_stock.description: Whether the product participates in document-driven stock movements (invoices, delivery notes). Requires the company `stock_management` module to be enabled. Defaults to `false`.

index.description: Position of the image in the gallery (0-based).

video.description: Product attached video, or `null` if there is none.

description.description: Free-text description of the product.
description.example: Vino tinto con Denominación de Origen Rioja, servido a granel en garrafa de 5 o 15 litros.
examples: Vino tinto con Denominación de Origen Rioja, servido a granel en garrafa de 5 o 15 litros.

tags.description: Product classification tags.

low_stock_threshold.description: Threshold below which stock is considered low, or `null` if not configured.

option_group_count.description: Number of option groups the product declares (active and inactive). Always reported, so a listing that omits `option_groups` for brevity never reads as a plain product.

configuration_count.description: Number of commercial combinations the product declares (active and inactive). Matches the size of `configurations` returned by the product detail.

catalog_availability_mode.description: `open` keeps the Cartesian product of active axes sellable; only configurations with `restricts_availability=true` constrain their own variant. `closed` treats all active configurations as the exact allow-list.

option_groups.description: Sellable option groups (finish, flavour, quality) with their values. Always an array; `[]` when the product declares none. Populated only when the caller asks for the configurable catalog.

configurations.description: Commercial configurations used for exact pricing and, depending on `catalog_availability_mode`, availability. In `open`, they do not restrict unless a row explicitly opts in. In `closed`, active rows form the exact allow-list; an empty active list means nothing is sellable.

is_low_stock.description: Indicates whether the current stock is below the configured threshold.

specifications.description: Structured technical specifications of the product (free key-value pairs). Empty object `{}` when there are no specifications.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this product to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, orthogonal to the catalog `sku` (a product may have both, neither, or either).

ProductActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of a product. Groups domain events originated by changes to the product itself and by documents whose lines reference it (invoices, quotes, etc.).

description.description: Human-readable description of the event in Spanish.
description.example: Se actualizó el precio base del producto.
examples: Se actualizó el precio base del producto.

metadata.description: Event metadata. Internal identifiers (PKs) are stripped; `*_uuid` values are preserved.

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID v7 of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

performed_by.description: Actor that originated the event. `{type:"user",...}` for an internal user, `{type:"api_key",...}` when performed via the public v1 API, or `null` when the event is system-generated (scheduler, periodic sweep) with no attributable actor.

ProductActivity.title: ProductActivity

ProductConfiguration.description: A valid commercial combination of a product: an optional variant, an optional presentation and a canonical set of option values.

name.description: Visible label composed from variant + presentation + values. It is not a stored column: the historical name is frozen by the document line, not by the catalog. It is also the text the price-list `search` filter matches.
name.example: Superior · Garrafa de 5 L · Calidad: Superior
examples: Superior · Garrafa de 5 L · Calidad: Superior

signature.description: Canonical, order-independent signature of variant + presentation + option values. Unique per product.

commercial_price.description: FINAL price per commercial unit. When set it ALREADY absorbs the adjustments of its option values: they are not added again.

restricts_availability.description: Only used in `open` mode. When true, this row constrains the named variant; omitted presentation/options are wildcards. False means the row is pricing/identity only.

ProductConfiguration.title: ProductConfiguration

ProductConfigurationOption.description: One chosen option inside a commercial combination.
ProductConfigurationOption.title: ProductConfigurationOption

ProductOptionGroup.description: A group of sellable options of a product (finish, flavour, quality). Each group accepts a single value per line; multiple selection is out of scope.

required.description: Whether a value of this group must be chosen to confirm a line.

scope_id.description: Scope of the group: `null` means it applies to the whole product; when set, it is the id of a variant or a presentation of the same product and the group only takes part in selections including it.

ProductOptionGroup.title: ProductOptionGroup

ProductOptionValue.description: A selectable value inside an option group.

price_adjustment.description: Additive adjustment PER COMMERCIAL UNIT. `null` means "this value does not change the price", which is NOT the same as `"0.0000"`.

active.description: Whether the value is still selectable. An inactive value keeps naming historical document lines.

ProductOptionValue.title: ProductOptionValue

unit.description: UN/ECE code of the commercial unit of the presentation. The nine measure units can also be a base unit; the thirteen count and packaging units (`H87` piece, `XPK` pack, `XBX` box, …) are valid only here and in supplier offers. It must be expressible over the base unit of the product: a packaging unit needs a declared equivalence (`conversion_factor` or `nominal_base_quantity`), a measure unit must belong to the same family as the base; otherwise 422 `unit_not_expressible`.

gross_weight_kg.description: Own gross transport weight in kg per COMMERCIAL unit (decimal string, up to 4 decimals, greater than 0), packaging included; it overrides any derivation from the product or variant weight. `null` when the presentation declares none. Rejected with 422 `gross_weight_not_allowed` on `variable_measure` presentations.

commercial_price_override.description: Own price PER COMMERCIAL UNIT, or `null` when the presentation declares none. Orthogonal to `conversion_factor`, which converts QUANTITY and is never reused as a price multiplier: a 3.5 kg tub priced at 50.00 is worth 50.00 per tub.

specifications.description: Technical specifications OWN to this presentation (informational, not selectable). Empty object `{}` when there are none. The effective sheet combines product < variant < presentation and is composed by the aggregate.

ProductReplacementLink.description: The OTHER end of a base unit replacement: on `replaces`, the old product the current one replaced; on `replaced_by`, the new product that replaced the current one.

id.description: Id of the other product.

base_unit.description: Base unit of the other product.

equivalence.description: Old base units per ONE new base unit, decimal string with scale 6. `null` between measure families with no declared equivalence.

stock_transferred.description: Stock moved to the new product, decimal string with scale 4, ALWAYS in the unit of the NEW product.

ProductReplacementLink.title: ProductReplacementLink

units_sold.description: Exact quantity sold, represented as a decimal string.

total_revenue.description: Revenue of the product (EUR), as a 2-decimal string.

ProductStats.description: Aggregated summary of the product catalog of the authenticated company: total, active, out of stock and low stock. Returned by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/products/stats`.

total_products.description: Total number of products registered in the company.

low_stock_count.description: Products whose stock is below the configured threshold.

ProductStats.title: ProductStats

gross_weight_kg.description: Own gross transport weight in kg per BASE unit (decimal string, up to 4 decimals, greater than 0) that replaces the product weight for this variant; `null` inherits the product weight. Rejected with 422 `gross_weight_not_allowed` when the product base unit is a mass unit.

specifications.description: Technical specifications OWN to this variant (informational, not selectable). Empty object `{}` when there are none. `base_price_override` stays PER BASE UNIT, unlike a presentation price, which is per commercial unit.

Proforma.description: A proforma invoice that can be converted to a final invoice.

status.description: Proforma lifecycle status (draft, accepted, rejected, cancelled, expired, converted).

price_list_id.description: UUID of the price list selected for this document.

price_list_name.description: Price-list name snapshot frozen on the document.

validity_days.description: Number of validity days of the proforma since its issuance. `null` if not applicable.

reference.description: Free reference of the document (e.g. the customer order number).

operation_regime.description: VAT operation regime of the proforma (`general`, `intracomunitaria`, `importacion_exportacion`, `isp`).

converted_to_id.description: UUID v7 of the invoice this proforma was converted into, if applicable.

converted_invoice_number.description: Human-readable number of the invoice this proforma was converted into (e.g. "F-2026-00042"). `null` if not converted.

taxes_total.description: NET aggregate of the header taxes: `total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`. It is the amount that, added to `subtotal`, yields `total` (`total === subtotal + taxes_total`), so it must NOT be combined with `total_retention`: subtracting the withholding again on top of the aggregate produces a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 − 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real total of 4,579.20). It is NOT the VAT figure of the Spanish Modelo 303 — read `total_vat` for that. Beware that on an expense the same field name carries a DIFFERENT meaning (VAT only), which is why the identity that holds across all five document families is the explicit one: `total === subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

total_vat.description: Sum of the VAT of all lines.

total_retention.description: Sum of the withholding (IRPF) of all lines.

total_surcharge.description: Sum of the equivalence surcharge of all lines.

total.description: Total of the document. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the five document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the AGGREGATE one, specific to the sales-side families - `total = subtotal + taxes_total`. NEVER reconstruct it as `subtotal + taxes_total - total_retention`: `taxes_total` ALREADY has the withholding netted out, so that combination subtracts it twice and yields a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 - 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real 4,579.20).

shipping_cost.description: Shipping cost, expressed WITH VAT INCLUDED, added to the amount to pay. It is not part of `subtotal`, `total_vat` or `total`. When the proforma is converted to an invoice it becomes a "Gastos de envío" line whose base is `shipping_cost / (1 + r)` with VAT `r`, so the invoice total equals `total_with_shipping`.

total_with_shipping.description: Final total including the shipping cost (= total + shipping_cost). The invoice generated from the proforma has exactly this total.

payment_method.description: Preferred payment method (backing value of the Shared enum `PaymentMethod`, e.g. `bank_transfer`).

payment_terms_days.description: Payment term in days (Net X). Valid range: 0-365.

delivery_terms.example: Entrega en 5 dias habiles, portes incluidos
examples: Entrega en 5 dias habiles, portes incluidos

terms_and_conditions.description: Terms and conditions rendered in the proforma PDF.
terms_and_conditions.example: Validez 30 dias. Proforma sin valor fiscal hasta su conversion en factura.
examples: Validez 30 dias. Proforma sin valor fiscal hasta su conversion en factura.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

tags.description: Free classification tags (lowercase slugs `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 40 chars each, ≤ 30 tags). Filterable via `?tags[in]=tag1,tag2` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics). Empty `[]` when there are none.

custom_fields.description: Ordered list of typed custom fields `[{field, value}]` (≤ 50). Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata. Empty `[]` when there are none.

link_expires_at.description: Expiration date of the shareable public link, or `null` if unlimited.

link_is_active.description: Indicates whether the shareable public link is currently active.

Proforma.title: Proforma

ProformaLine.description: A line item on a proforma.

additional_description.description: Optional secondary description rendered below the line concept on document PDFs.
additional_description.example: Auditoría inicial e informe de mejoras

unit_price.description: Unit price as a decimal STRING with the 4-decimal scale of its column (e.g. `"0.0125"`, `"100.0000"`): it is returned exactly as it was accepted and stored, so reading a line and sending it back never changes its price. Derived amounts (`subtotal`, `taxes`, `total`) keep 2 decimals.

retention_rate.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime of the line: the per-document override (`iva`/`igic`/`ipsi`) when the user set it (precedence override>zone), otherwise `null` (derived from the establishment AEAT zone). Writable per-document input on create/update; the document must be homogeneous (a single non-null regime across all lines, 422 otherwise).

counted_quantity.description: Pieces the customer asked for on a variable-weight line sold by count (decimal string, scale 4, greater than 0), e.g. `"4.0000"` for four pieces weighing `quantity` kg in total. Informational: the line is charged and the stock is discounted by `quantity` (the real weight), never by the pieces. `null` on any other line. Only accepted on a `variable_measure` presentation whose unit is a count unit.

counted_unit.description: UN/ECE code of the count unit of `counted_quantity` (`H87` piece, `XPK` pack…). `null` exactly when `counted_quantity` is `null`.

configuration.description: Commercial combination frozen on the line, or `null` when the line was not sold or bought through one (legacy product, manual line).

options.description: Configurable options frozen on the line, in printing order. Always an array, `[]` included.

price_adjustment.description: Adjustment of the chosen value per commercial unit. `null` means the value does not change the price — NOT the same as adjusting by `0`.

applied.description: Whether that amount was actually ADDED to the unit price. `false` when an exact price (price-list entry, combination price or a manually typed unit price) already absorbed it.

price_semantics.description: Monetary semantics of the resolved price: `per_base_unit` (product/variant own price, converted once by the presentation factor) or `per_commercial_unit` (presentation, combination or price-list entry, never converted). `null` on a line with no catalog price context.

price_adjustment_total.description: Sum of the adjustments of the chosen option values, as a decimal string. Informational when an exact price already absorbed them.

option_adjustments_absorbed.description: TRI-STATE, and `null` is NOT `false`. `true`: the resolved price already includes the option adjustments. `false`: they were added on top. `null`: it could not be determined — the assembler refuses such a line with 422 rather than risking charging the adjustments twice, so `null` only ever reaches a reader on a legacy line with no configurable options at all.

ProformaLine.title: ProformaLine

ProformaStats.description: Aggregated summary of the proformas of the authenticated company: total, accumulated amount, breakdown by status (with count and amount), conversion-to-invoice ratio, those about to expire and average value. Returned by `GET /v1/companies/{company}/proformas/stats`.

total_amount.description: Aggregate amount of the proformas (EUR), as a 2-decimal string.

count.description: Number of proformas in this state.

total.description: Aggregate amount of the proformas in this status (EUR), as a 2-decimal string.

conversion_rate.description: Conversion-to-invoice ratio (invoiced proformas / total), as a percentage from 0 to 100 with up to 2 decimals.

expiring_soon.description: Proformas whose `valid_until` date expires in the coming days.

average_value.description: Average value of the proformas (EUR), as a 2-decimal string.

ProformaStats.title: ProformaStats

Project.description: A task project of your company: its board columns hold the tasks, and its key (`DEV`) prefixes their keys (`DEV-12`).

id.description: UUID v7 of the project.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `project` for this resource.

key.description: Project key, unique in your company. Prefixes the key of every task (`DEV-12`).

name.description: Project name.

icon.description: Icon of the project, from the task icon catalog.

description.description: Free description of the project, or `null`.
description.example: Evolutivos y correcciones de la tienda online.
examples: Evolutivos y correcciones de la tienda online.

position.description: Position of the project in the list shown in the app.

is_archived.description: `true` when the project is archived (read-only, no new tasks).

archived_at.description: When the project was archived, or `null`.

billing_contact_id.description: UUID of the contact invoiced by default for the logged time, or `null`.

billing_hourly_rate.description: Default hourly rate (decimal string, before taxes) used to invoice the logged time, or `null`.

billing_product_id.description: UUID of the product used for the invoice lines of logged time, or `null`.

total_tasks.description: Tasks of the project, archived ones included.

completion_percentage.description: Completed tasks over total, as a whole percentage.

next_due_on.description: Earliest due date among the open tasks, or `null`.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp.

ProjectColumn.description: A column of a project board. Tasks in a final column (`is_final`) are completed.

project_id.description: UUID of the project the column belongs to.

name.description: Column name.

slug.description: Stable identifier derived from the name, unique in the project (`planned` and `archived` are reserved).

ProjectCustomField.description: A custom field defined for the tasks of a project.

ProvisionManagedAccountV1Request.description: Provision a managed account for one of your clients. Required: `external_ref` (your own reference, unique per provider: repeating it returns the same account), `plan` (`emprendedor`, `empresario` or `integral`), `tax_id` (Spanish tax ID) and `legal_name`. `access_level` is the level your account keeps on it (`none` by default). `owner_email` is required with a live key and whenever `send_email` is `true`; `send_email` is `false` by default, so the claim voucher comes back ONCE in the response for you to deliver. The rest of the fiscal profile (`display_name`, address, `language`) is optional. The provider is always the account of the key and never comes from the body; the environment of the new account is the one of the key.

external_ref.description: Your own reference for the account (up to 128 characters), unique per provider. Provisioning it again returns the same account (200) without a new voucher.

plan.description: Plan of the managed account: `emprendedor`, `empresario` or `integral`. `enterprise` returns 422 `managed_account_plan_not_self_serve`.

access_level.description: Access level your account keeps on the managed account: `none` (default, provisioning only), `view` (read-only) or `operate`.

tax_id.description: Spanish tax identifier (NIF, CIF or NIE) of the managed account.

legal_name.description: Legal name of the managed account.

display_name.description: Visible name of the account and of its tax ID; without it, the legal name.

language.description: Language of the account and of its claim voucher: `es` (default), `en` or `ca`.

owner_email.description: Email of the holder of the account. Required with a live key and whenever `send_email` is `true`.

send_email.description: Email the claim link to `owner_email` (`true`) or return the voucher once in the response (`false`, default).

ProvisioningUsage.description: Provisioning usage of your account as a provider: its managed accounts with the management in force, its managed account limit and what it pays for them on top of their fee.

managed_accounts.description: Managed accounts with the management in force, by environment. Test ones never count towards `limit`.

limit.description: Maximum number of live managed accounts of your account.

remaining.description: Live managed accounts that still fit within `limit` (never negative).

managed_accounts_by_plan.description: Live managed accounts with the management in force, by plan. Every plan of the catalog is always present (0 when there is none).

provider_paid_additional_nifs.description: Additional tax IDs of your managed accounts that your account pays.

provider_paid_employee_seats.description: Employee seats of your managed accounts that your account pays.
